entities.name: UL RRC message segmentation procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by a UE in RRC_CONNECTED state when uplink RRC message segmentation is enabled and the RRC message exceeds PDCP SDU size limits.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where the UE has an established RRC connection.

entities.name: rrc-SegAllowed
entities.description: Field indicating whether RRC message segmentation is enabled.

entities.name: RRC message segmentation enabled
entities.description: Condition where rrc-SegAllowed field indicates segmentation is allowed.

entities.name: RRC message larger than PDCP SDU maximum
entities.description: Condition where the encoded RRC message exceeds the maximum PDCP SDU size specified in TS 38.323.

entities.name: UL Dedicated Message Segment
entities.description: Message transmitted by UE when initiating UL RRC message segmentation procedure.

relations.description: UL RRC message segmentation procedure requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state.
Procedure initiation is guarded by the condition that RRC message segmentation is enabled.
Procedure initiation is guarded by the condition that RRC message exceeds PDCP SDU maximum size.
Condition is established based on the value of rrc-SegAllowed field.
Procedure includes transmission of UL Dedicated Message Segment message.
